newsitem.title: USA: Watsco completes buy of 2 Carrier Corp units.
newsitem.headline: Watsco completes buy of 2 Carrier Corp units.

text.p: Watsco Inc said Tuesday it has completed the previously announced acquisition of two distribution operations from United Technologies Corp's Carrier Corp affiliate. The transaction is expected to be accretive to Watsco's earnings.

The operations, Comfort Products Distributing and Central Plains Distributing, sell air conditioning and heating equipment to over 4,800 air conditioning and heating contractors under the "Carrier," "Bryant" and "Payne" brand names and together reported 1996 revenues of approximately $65 million.
The purchase price was not immediately available.
